name: Named Position 3
definition: Type of detailed aggregated position set report between a pair of counterparties.

GeneralInformation.name: General Information
GeneralInformation.definition: Report containing aggregation of loan and collateral exposures between counterparties by Securities Financing Transaction type, for a limited number of fields.

Loan.name: Loan
Loan.definition: Aggregation of data for all transactions pertaining to the loan side, by Securities Financing Transaction type.

Collateral.name: Collateral
Collateral.definition: Aggregation of data for all submissions pertaining to the collateral side, by Securities Financing Transaction type.

Margin.name: Margin
Margin.definition: Aggregation of data related to margin reported for cleared Securities Financing Transactions at the level of each pair of entities and portfolio code.

Reuse.name: Reuse
Reuse.definition: Aggregation of data on collateral reuse transactions, at entity level.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
